answer: By coupling recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with a sequential verifiable delay function, we impose an insurmountable temporal bottleneck on identity creation. To execute a Sybil attack, adversaries must post substantial staking collateral that faces immediate slashing penalties if double-signing occurs, securing a robust Nash equilibrium of negative expected utility. This mechanism acts as a digital quill, etching immutable proofs into a glacier of decentralized consensus, transforming the network into a cryptoeconomic haven.
